Dear [Mr Craik](/person/379)
I send the end of [the Story of the Christians and Moors](/book/126). It makes 27 chapters, and I think more would outrun the limits besides the history of the poor Moriscos is so piteous that I do not like to go into it

Yours truly

C M Yonge
